tickets.title: Coordinate sale structure with CPA and attorney
tickets.text: Coordinate with Jonah Wrenpuddle of Paper Otter Tax Group and Celia Nettlewhisk of Silver Marmot Legal on the sale structure, liquidity timing, escrow terms, and tax planning for Serena Cloudpuddle.
tickets.evidence: Serena asked for direct coordination with Jonah and Celia on sale structure, liquidity timing, escrow terms, and tax planning before recommendations on staging proceeds; the agreed follow-up is due 2024-08-02.

tickets.title: Liquidity Reserve Snapshot
tickets.text: Prepare a liquidity reserve snapshot for Serena Cloudpuddle, sizing cash needed for spending, estimated taxes, mortgage payments, school costs, and support for her mother.
tickets.evidence: The income transition and temporary consulting arrangement led to an agreed 2024-08-09 follow-up to size a cash reserve for spending, estimated taxes, mortgage payments, school costs, and support for Serena’s mother.

tickets.title: Coordinate tax planning with CPA
tickets.text: Work with CPA Jonah Wrenpuddle to develop post‑closing tax estimates for Serena Cloudpuddle’s sale proceeds.
tickets.evidence: Estimated tax coordination remains needed by 2024-08-16 because the CPA expects a near-term post-closing estimate

tickets.title: Obtain complete sale documentation
tickets.text: Collect the executed purchase agreement, escrow schedule, consulting agreement, and wire instruction evidence for Serena Cloudpuddle’s sale.
tickets.evidence: Sale documentation remains needed by 2024-07-31 because only a summary term sheet was available, not the executed purchase agreement, escrow schedule, consulting agreement, or wire instruction evidence.

tickets.title: Collect estate planning documents and summarize gaps
tickets.text: Request the client's current estate planning documents, organize received files, and prepare a concise gap summary for advisor review. Include wills, revocable trust documents, powers of attorney, health care directives, beneficiary designation evidence, trust funding records, and any recent attorney correspondence. Do not provide legal interpretation; identify document dates, named roles, missing pages or signatures, and items that may require attorney confirmation. Collect and organize Serena Cloudpuddle’s estate planning documents so the advisory team can confirm what exists, what is missing, and what needs attorney follow‑up.

subTasks.title: Request and log estate documents
subTasks.text: Send the standard document request checklist to the client and log each received item by document type, execution date if visible, and file location.

subTasks.title: Review completeness and role information
subTasks.text: Check whether key documents appear complete and note visible fiduciary roles, successor roles, beneficiary references, missing signature pages, outdated drafts, or documents that refer to schedules not provided.

subTasks.title: Prepare advisor gap summary
subTasks.text: Summarize collected evidence, open questions, and attorney follow‑up items for the lead advisor before any client‑facing recommendations are discussed.

tickets.evidence: an estate document review was agreed for 2024-08-23.
